items.note: N1 states the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch wires and the subtract/copy-gather/scatter-inject/undo schedule, and N1.2 gives the three-stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). The essential coefficient check (central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2 or (|S∩T|-1)/2, with the side wires cancelling the rest) appears only as 'intersection-size coefficients so that the unwanted ones cancel'. h=100, the triples and the neighbour rules are not given.

N2 states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, with edges implemented by D_v D_u^{-1}. The method gives the paper's invariant (stored = frame applied to logical) and the fact that a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate (lines 804-813).

The nested nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3}, the single decreasing edge type (centre 3->4, loss h) and the ratios L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are stated. L=Ich and the budget sum|Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L are not; N3 only says the total is 'below W·m'. The telescoping argument (sources sum to N, sinks to Wm-N) and the use of t_X ⊥ t_Y on the side edge 2->5 are missing from the method.

The statement is right: endpoint identity M_sink(ρ(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m, s_b < W_b m with deficit N-2L_b, and a shear H<-H+D on every role. The method (P_U on gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} on the X_a sources, rank = dimension change) leaves out that the N source edges are exceptions, each 2P_{U_a} of rank one with zero dimension change (lines 1162-1165). That exception is what turns -2N into -N.

It has one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c < W_c m, and C^{⊗m} on every role after telescoping. The derivation follows the paper: weight additivity mod 4, odd weight giving one kernel, and C=iZC^{-1}Z on the 27k inverse factors. Two things are loose. The frame is written as the phase i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4} itself rather than its Hadamard conjugate H^{⊗m} diag(...) H^{⊗m} (line 1193). The formula s_c = W_c m - 2N + 2L_c is not given.

Stated: L/N < 1/2, the strict saving s < Wm in both networks, deficits above 20·2^{-50}, and s/W < m^τ with τ = 1-2^{-50}. The exponential estimate behind it (log m < 20, m^{1-2^{-50}} > m(1-η)) is not shown, and the exact η values are omitted.

The digit split/merge, cyclic row split and controlled shift by cut-and-remerge follow lines 513-527 and 574-604. T2 drops the condition that the offset be computable in b^{O(1)} time from the controls (line 566).

It has A=E_1ΠE_2 by topmost-row, rightmost-entry elimination; the conjugation by E_2 and E_1^{-1}; and each pivot as a controlled shift, an interchange and a controlled shift, so exactly a interchanges, as in the paper.

It covers the cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, shears Φ_{A_e} on edges, H<-H+D on every row, the three updates giving the interchange, s calls, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1} + O(1) solved to O(e^τ), and the fixed-tape parking schedule at O(V) per node. All of this matches the paper.
It has the high-digit row field of range >= W^k with padding, the base-m decomposition with a geometric sum O(Ve^τ), and padding binary ranges to [q^e]. This is the paper's proof.

It covers P_M conjugation to coordinate kernels, M as fixed row additions on slots, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, inverse children via Z wrappers, H_0^{⊗D} = b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D, and the basis change at O(V((eK)^τ+1)). All as in the paper.

It has the eight rotations giving the two three-cycles, guard interval [10, 2^{K-1}-11], bad fraction 80(f-1)2^{-K} by a union bound, the repair of T_0 S_0^{-1} on B by stable radix sort, and a final two-bit XOR. This follows the proof.

Node overhead, rows from the first q_0 chunks, the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m) + O((eK)^τ+1) and O(d^{λ'}) per unit volume are present. L2.3 says the recurrence 'sums to O(e^λ)' under a < m^λ. In the paper only the internal costs give O(e^λ), using K <= e^{c/β} and a <= m^σ. The leaves e < d^β add O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), which is what forces λ' > σ+β(1-σ) (lines 2413-2430, 2444).

It covers O(V d^{λ'}) and exact evaluation with p+Δ fractional and Δ+3 integer bits, Δ = ⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉ from A(e) <= sA(e/m) + E, εC_1 < 1 giving Δ = o(p), and a single truncation with error < √2·2^{-p} since H has row sums one. Matches lines 2479-2586 and 2686-2758.

It covers character cancellation by the shift t/2^{v+1}, DIF recursion, bit-reversed storage with B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, the prefix moves and chunk exchanges defining L, the cost O(Tp[dK + pK^{τ-1} + ℓd^{λ'}]) and the error √2·ℓ·2^{-p}. Faithful to the paper.
It has B_0 = 2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, centred-residue extraction from |h_j| < B_0/2, negacyclic reduction and the cost O(rp log(rp)), as in the paper.
It keeps the common LB order, multiplies by signed packing, applies the opposite transform and scales by M. The error 3δ+η before scaling gives √2·M(3ℓ+1)·2^{-p}, and the cost is stated correctly.

It has T P_s F_s = P_t F_t S, ||N-I|| < 1/2, the left inverse D N^{-1} C giving P_s F_s = 2^{2α^2} B_0 P_t F_t A, the cited ordered maps, tensoring, and axis exposure with O(d^2) interchanges. All match the paper.

It has the chirp identity by comparing coefficients, R F^+ R = F^+ by dilation substitution, permutations commuting with pointwise products, the normalized convolution rule giving S^{-2}, and conjugation for RF^+.

The exponent list, sizes, α, γ = o(b), the prime intervals with T/2 < S < T, trial division and the no-wraparound digit polynomials are all correct. The value η = 1/(4d), which drives both the prime count and α^4 θ_i > p (lines 4092, 4146-4149), is never given.

It has Φ: x -> ∏ x_i^{μ_i} with μ_i = P_i^{-1}, an isomorphism; a triangular update from i=d down to 1 by prefix-controlled rotations of the valid interval; and the cost O(Tp d^2 (1+ℓ^τ)). The explicit formula b_i is only described in words.
It has (ζy)^r = 1, the diagonal twist and the wrap factor ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h = ζ^j. Computed twists have error 2·2^{-p} and wrap the synthetic convolution.

It has the source transform 2^γ B_0 Q F_t A = R F_s, conjugation for the opposite sign, and the algorithm sequence with scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, plus the explanation of the two S factors (A8, A9). A's own summary says 'S and 2^{2b+4}', dropping the second S, but A8 is exact.
It covers contraction and bilinear error propagation, the chirp error 8TL, E_s = 9·2^γ·TL, the opposite error (3E_s+2), the final bound 448b·2^{-3b/4} < 1/2, and the carry invariant. As in the paper.
It covers the cost table divided by Tp, margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2 = 2^{-181} = 2κ, logarithmic factors absorbed by p^κ, and schoolbook multiplication below a cutoff, matching the paper.
R lists 'nlogn-conjecture' among its dependencies and its motivation refers to n log n scanning cost. No step states that the bound refutes an eventual c_A·n·lg n lower bound (liminf = 0).

errors.says: With exponents chosen so that a=s/W<m^λ, the recurrence F(e) <= (s/W)F(e/m) + O((eK)^τ+1) sums to O(e^λ).
errors.paper: Only the internal-node costs sum to O(e^λ) (using K <= e^{c/β} and a <= m^σ < m^λ). The leaves e < d^β contribute O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), and σ is chosen with σ >= log_m(s/W). The final bound is O(d^{λ'}) with λ' > max{λ, σ+β(1-σ)}.

errors.says: Method: edge differences are projections onto residuals, whose rank is the dimension change.
errors.paper: This holds except on the N source edges of X_a, whose matrix is 2P_{U_a}, of rank one, where the dimension change is zero. These exceptions are why s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b rather than W_b m - 2N + 2L_b.

errors.says: The Gaussian-dyadic network uses phase frames i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}.
errors.paper: The frame is C_U = H^{⊗m} diag_x(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{⊗m}, the Hadamard conjugate of that phase. The kernels aI+bX_v arise only after this conjugation.

errors.says: ... compute the opposite transform, rescale by S and 2^{2b+4}, round ...
errors.paper: The second scale is 2^{2b+4}·S, not 2^{2b+4}. The two occurrences of S undo different normalizations of (u*v)/S^2.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. It goes from the bank-exchange network and frames, through labels, the rational and phase interfaces and the strict saving s<Wm, to the interchange and layer recurrences. From there it runs through the transforms, convolution, resampling, CRT, recovery and the cost table. It thins at the dimension budget: the label sum Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich and the N rank-one source exceptions are not stated, only the resulting deficit N-2L_b > 0. The layer recurrence's leaf contribution and the log m < 20 estimate behind τ = 1-2^{-50} are also not shown.

steps.note: N1 gives the fixed network of copy, gather, scatter and side-injection gates exchanging banks as (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) in three stages and restoring every scratch wire, with its schedule. The parameters h=100, N = C(h,3)^3 and m = h^3 are not given numerically. Triples and m appear only through the labels in N3.
There is a common invertible frame per vertex that commutes with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S_Ω D_in^{-1}, and each edge as a change of frame D_v D_u^{-1}.
There are nested nondegenerate subspace labels in the m-dimensional F^{⊗3}, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decrease, each losing h.

N4's method states that edge differences are projections onto residuals with rank equal to the dimension change. The N rank-one source exceptions appear only as 'extra source ranks' in N3.2, without their count or form.

N4.1's deficit N-2L_b is equivalent to s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b. The budget itself (sum|Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L with L = Ich, from source and sink dimension sums) is never stated. N3 says only that the total is below Wm.
It has L_b/N = 100/539 and L_c/N = 101/539, both below 1/2, giving deficit N-2L_b > 0 and so s_b < W_b m.
M_sink(ρ(w)) - M_source(w) = I_m on every role (P_{U_a^⊥} - (-P_{U_a}) for X_a, 0 to I otherwise), so the bit network applies H<-H+D on every row.
There is a rank-a shear via A = E_1 Π E_2 with exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each edge implemented by recursive interchanges, and a fixed number s of child calls per node.
Children have volume V/W, F_k <= (s/W)F_{k-1} + O(1), s/W < m^τ with τ = 1-2^{-50} because the deficits exceed 20·2^{-50}, and F_k = O(e^τ). The companion fact log m < 20 is not mentioned.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost end to end: the exchange network, frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change, the strict saving from L/N < 1/2, the endpoint shear, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with τ = 1-2^{-50}. The weak link is the dimension budget. Wm-2N+2L, L = Ich and the N rank-one source exceptions that turn it into s_b = W_b m - N + 2L_b are absent or only alluded to. The plan jumps from the per-edge facts to the deficit N-2L_b.
